articles.title: India Women South Africa Tour 2026: स्मृति मंधाना कप्तान, दिसंबर का शेड्यूल जारी
verifiedClaims: BCCI advisory dated 9 November 2026: Smriti Mandhana captain for Test/ODI/T20I; Deepti Sharma Test/ODI vice-captain; Shafali Verma T20I vice-captain. One Test starts 9 December at Gqeberha; ODIs 16/19/22 December at Paarl/Cape Town/Bloemfontein; T20Is 26/29/30 December at Benoni/Potchefstroom/Potchefstroom.

Test/ODI squads have 15 players and T20I 17, counted from original lists. Harmanpreet Kaur and Jemimah Rodrigues present in all three. Sneh Rana in Test, Vaishnavi Sharma in ODI. No selection-reason, match time, broadcast or ticket claim.
Material update corrects old captaincy assertion and removes insufficiently sourced rankings/training claims; original URL and publishedAt retained, clear change note added.

articles.title: दिल्ली का AQI अलग-अलग क्यों दिखता है? CPCB का पैमाना और PM2.5 का फर्क समझें
verifiedClaims: Fresh CPCB original PDFs verify six national AQI bands 0-50/51-100/101-200/201-300/301-400/401-500, pollutant concentration versus index, eight pollutants and worst sub-index method.

CPCB calculation PDF: 24-hour values except 8-hour CO/O3; running-average example; minimum three pollutants including PM2.5 or PM10. Limitations PDF records technical/operational interruptions. No live AQI value, independent app-accuracy test, new GRAP/school/vehicle order or treatment instruction.
November 9 Indian Express report used only for current context of differing official/private readings. Numeric hypotheticals clearly labelled, not presented as measurements.
